selected.prompt: Make a color-only edit of this exact no-text technical drawing. Preserve EVERY component position, margin, scale, all grids/row and column counts, node counts, connectors, arrow direction, line endpoints, layer glyphs and label whitespace. Never redraw its topology or rearrange content. Apply the palette to EVERY colored frame, fill, circle, bar, arrow and line; leave NO original high saturation pigment. Blue/cyan becomes muted #7188A3 and #E5EAF0; green#829C8B/E8EEE9; yellow/orange#B4A16F/F1ECDD; red/pink#A7787D/F0E5E6;purple#9588A5/ECE8F0. Main networks, states and ordinary output modules are BLUE; only secondary branches green, gates/position yellow, losses/gradients red. Except scientifically needed class divisions, do not use bright red/orange/cyan or multicolored rainbow. All ordinary rectangles gently rounded; preserve factor squares, matrix cells and feature-map silhouettes as meaningful shapes. Purewhiteflatbackground, no textures, no gradients, no text or pseudo text. cnn-channel-connectivity-comparison exact original canvas 1681×936px.
